query: We are ending our marriage. There have never been any kids, and I just need the basic starting checklist.
No kids in this divorce. I first said the wedding was June 14, then remembered it was actually June 16.
We have no children. I know we split up around last autumn, but I cannot remember the day I moved out.
I want a divorce and there are no children. Nobody has asked where I currently live yet.
We have no children. I know where I live, but my spouse disappeared and I have no idea where to find them.
We are divorcing without kids and both of our names are on the apartment. I want the draft to mention what happens to it.
There are no children. We are splitting up and need to describe the balance we borrowed together for the car.
This is a divorce without kids. Please use my separate email because my spouse can read our joint inbox.
We want a divorce, and our marriage has two children. Which basic child details should this pretend draft include?
In our divorce intake, the children are named Alia and Alina. I am worried their birthdays will get swapped.
We have children and are divorcing. I gave one child's birthday wrong earlier and then stated the right date later.
I am divorcing with a child, but I only remember the birth month and am not confident about the day.
During my divorce call I mentioned that we have kids, but the interviewer never got their names or ages.
As part of the divorce I want the children with me for seven days, then with their other parent for the next seven.
We are divorcing. I would like the children here Monday through Friday and visiting their other parent on weekends.
In the divorce, one child would live mostly with me while the other would follow a different visiting pattern.
I want to revise the parenting arrangement we already have, rather than begin a divorce. Where do I start?
We already have a parenting order, but I cannot remember when it was issued. I want to modify it.
I know when the existing parenting order was made, but I cannot find its reference number for this change request.
I need to adjust our current child arrangements because I am moving to another town in a few months.
Our child is starting at a campus across town, so I want the existing visiting times changed to suit the new timetable.
My employer put me on night duty. The parenting schedule we already use no longer fits, and I want different hours.
We currently swap the children at my house, but I want future exchanges at the library instead.
I am an adult seeking a new name on its own, with no divorce or child arrangement involved. What basic facts are needed?
I want to change my own name because one letter is wrong, and I need the exact corrected version kept.
As an adult I want to go back to the name I used years ago. This request is separate from any marriage case.
I have chosen a new adult name because it feels like who I am. Please use only the explanation I actually give.
My requested surname combines two family names with a dash between them, in a particular order.
For my adult name request, I want to be known by just one word, with no separate last name.
I am asking for an adult name change, but I only know the year I was born and cannot give a full birthday.
